newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Nov 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Fidel Ramos says he will respect Malaysia's decision to deport 11 Filipinos who are to attend a conference in Kuala Lumpur on East Timor (ALL PAPERS)
- Evander Holyfield knocks out Mike Tyson in the 11th round in one of the bigest upsets in boxing history to claim his heavyweight championship of the world for a third time. (ALL PAPERS)
- Philippine authorities step up preparations to safeguard Asia Pacific leaders as opposition to their November 25 summit intensifies (MANILA BULLETIN)
- The real value of wages has dropped by 60 percent in the last 10 years despite four wage adjustments since 1989, a legislator representing labour sector claims. (MANILA TIMES)
- The Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) is expected to adjust petroleum prices for the fourth time since August under a partially deregulated market, ERB chairman Bayani Faylona says. (BUSINESSWORLD)

- The World Bank is urging the government to adopt several measures, including keeping a tight monetary policy and realigning the tax sytstem for foreign currecncy deposit units, to effectively rein in inflation. (MANILA TIMES)
